policy_presence.summary: Retained public Claims show scoped institutional material. Currentness and complete policy coverage remain PARTIAL.

ai_disclosure.summary: The historical 2025–26 disclosure provisions do not establish today’s requirements. Current acknowledgement conditions remain a gap.

coursework.summary: The IAG working group discusses university work; its discussion does not establish permission for your coursework.

exams.summary: The retained 2025–26 exam records are historical. Current exam permission is unresolved here; check the rules for your exam.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The retained working-group Claims provide no specific data-upload rule. This gap does not mean uploading sensitive material is permitted.

academic_integrity.summary: The working-group article does not establish a current misconduct procedure, sanction or appeal deadline. Historical exam records remain separately traceable.

approved_tools.summary: No tool entitlement is established by the retained Claims. A working-group initiative is not an account or licence offer.

named_ai_services.summary: Named services in retained Claims are discovery context only; eligibility and assessment permission remain unverified.

teaching_guidance.summary: The IAG group supports teaching and research practices. Its law-faculty guide is described as being drafted, not as an adopted assessment rule.

research_guidance.summary: The working group aims to support good practices in research and discusses academic dissertations; no specific thesis-use permission is established.

security_procurement.summary: No specific security or procurement process is established by the retained Claims. Consult the responsible university service for your use case.
